root.all_eight_torques_zero: The first four vanish at the unique root; exact reflection makes the remaining four their negatives.

transverse.argument: Clique fibers contribute n_i I on zero-sum vectors. Complete blocks vanish between class-zero-sum spaces. For a partial biregular block both A and J-A give operator bounds, so ||A|| is bounded by the smaller present/complement degree product. Cauchy-Schwarz reduces all transverse modes to the certified comparison matrix.

theorem.equilibrium: strictly stable nonsynchronous equilibrium modulo rotation
